label: Bible Study
prompt: For I am not _____ of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verse: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
note: Paul wrote this to Rome before he ever visited — the theme verse of the whole letter.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I say unto you, that likewise _____ shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
verse: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
note: Heaven throws a bigger party for one returning sheep than for ninety-nine that never wandered.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jacob was left alone; and there _____ a man with him until the breaking of the day.
verse: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
note: Jacob wrestled until daybreak and walked away with a limp and a new name: Israel.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a _____ people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
verse: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
note: 'Peculiar' here means God's own possession, not odd — though the world may struggle to tell the difference.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am _____; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
verse: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
note: Isaiah sees the Lord high and lifted up and cries 'I am undone' — unraveled first, then sent.
